integrity: Analytic radial decomposition proves every sample-size and tail claim; the attached exact-arithmetic program checks finite algebra only. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Proved for a scalar stationary OU diffusion with iid Gaussian training nodes and one non-generator-invariant quadratic observable. No claim for other dictionaries, non-iid data, Gram regularization, trajectories or long-time propagation. The public source gives high-probability finite-data estimates; this finding concerns unconditional moments.
title: A sharp eight-sample mean-square barrier for Richardson stochastic dynamic mode decomposition
